build_BBoxL1Cost: build a python module to compute L1 distance cost between predicted and ground truth bounding boxes
build_FocalLossCost: build a python module to compute focal loss cost between classification predictions and ground truth labels
build_ClassificationCost: build a python module to compute softmax classification cost between predictions and ground truth labels
build_IoUCost: build a python module to compute IoU or GIoU cost between predicted and ground truth bounding boxes
review_MATCH_COST_classes: review the BBoxL1Cost, FocalLossCost, ClassificationCost, and IoUCost classes for object detection bipartite matching
